Combining magnetocaloric materials with transition metals can tune the magnetic transition temperature and optimize the magnetocaloric effect through changes in the density of states and magnetic exchange

Reducing the size of magnetocaloric materials to the nanoscale can lead to enhanced magnetocaloric properties due to increased surface area, modified magnetic anisotropy, and altered magnetic domain structures
